description: Get the best swap route across DEX aggregator venues. Returns the winning venue quote plus every venue quote for transparency, and the fee recipient address (auditable against get_meta). Cross-chain quotes (e.g. USDT on Arbitrum -> USDC on Base) are supported on EVM.

amount.description: Integer amount in base units of the sell token, e.g. '100000000000000000' for 0.1 WETH

address.description: ERC-20 address (EVM) or SPL mint (Solana); 'native' for the gas asset
ERC-20 address (EVM) or SPL mint (Solana); 'native' for the gas asset

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points, default 50

title: Get best swap quote
